cost_quantity_requirements.notes: One free aggregate Claim per current ready batch per pass, followed by one free dispatch per distinct current ready chest. No paid or unknown-cost control is admissible.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: If the aggregate Claim is absent or not actionable, dispatch none and still inspect ready chests; if no ready chest remains, defer without input. Unknown, stale, clipped, non-free, contradictory, or ambiguous batch/chest state blocks without dispatch.
bounded_recovery_behavior: A dispatch-bearing unknown aggregate or chest successor becomes effect_reconciliation_required, vetoes completion, and denies identical retry. Observe only for reconciliation. Return to canonical Home only after all dispatched aggregate/chest effects are semantically verified and every current ready chest has been resolved.

canonical Home terminal proof and exact total consequential-action accounting
current native uninterrupted evidence is required; retained row-local Claim receipts do not establish combined-route acceptance
